token.label: Bolna AI API Key
token.description:
To get your API Key:

1. Login to the dashboard at https://platform.bolna.ai
2. Navigate to Developers tab from the left menu bar after login
3. Click the button Generate a new API Key to generate a key
4. Get your API Key

makePhoneCall.label: Make Phone Call
makePhoneCall.description: Initiate an outbound phone call from a Bolna Voice AI agent to a recipient.

agentId.label: Agent
agentId.description: Select the Bolna Voice AI agent

recipientPhoneNumber.label: Recipient Phone Number
recipientPhoneNumber.description: Phone number of the recipient with country code (E.164 format, e.g., +10123456789)

fromPhoneNumber.label: From Phone Number
fromPhoneNumber.description: Phone number of the sender with country code (E.164 format, e.g., +19876543007). Optional.

scheduledAt.label: Scheduled At
scheduledAt.description: The scheduled date and time in ISO 8601 format with time zone (e.g., 2025-08-21T10:35:00Z). Leave empty to call immediately.

userData.label: User Data
userData.description: Additional user dynamic variables as defined in the agent prompt (JSON object)
